clauses.text: two earned tiers then finished

Gold pips on the base wear the rank
the grown aura
the generator's Twin burner grows the aura a third and pours stamina back

figure.note: pinned at ×1.3 (400 → 520) — the game's own 'a third' since v3.21 (src/15_systems.js:1233; the upgrade's text says 'a third' too): the record's word rounds it

clauses.text: the healing hearth
its Hearth housing HEALS whoever rests by the fire
paid-for upgrades refused broke
the watchtower raises The horn, then the Armed post
the horn call and the post knock
A scrapper chasing you under a horn tower's watch is CALLED OUT — "THE TOWER SEES YOU" — and slowed to two-thirds pace

figure.note: pinned at ×0.7 of the same chase before the horn (DATA.T.towerSlow) — the game's 'two-thirds': the record's word rounds it

clauses.text: an armed post knocks a runner sprawling as it passes beneath
ten-armed camp shrinkage measured by chase-closure before/after
the camps nearby shrink their claim and slow their feet
the letter and the regard
Every crate of hand tools given — at the donate desk or through the box — arms one walker at that town, counted aloud
At ten, the town says so out loud: the announce, a letter, the town's regard — and an ARMED WATCH walks the yard's edge with lamps

figure.note: the ninth crate is only counted aloud; the tenth brings the announce, the letter, the regard and the watch

clauses.text: no-door-then-door
the shelter opens The room, then makes The bed
A tier-2 shelter is enterable: step in and the walker rests unseen behind a lit doorway
the grab-proof rest
stamina pours back
the healing bed and step-out
the bed wants timber
the tier-3 bed closes wounds and mends battered cargo while you breathe. Any step is a step out
the box's stash/law/take/donate cycle
The PO Box (6 metal): stash the loose load on the road — mission crates stay on your back, THE LAW

figure.note: the box's cost reads 6 metal and raising it spends 6 (at the porter's build-cost multiplier)

clauses.text: take it back later, or leave it for the walkers: donated hand tools ARM a waylighter, the rest earns regard
